fonts.display: 'Founders Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Founders Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Primary text, filled action buttons, and dominant borders — near-black provides maximum contrast against the warm cream canvas

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Page canvas and soft surface washes — the warm off-white foundation of every section

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, button text, and inverted text on black — the cleanest layer above cream

palette.name: Lavender Mist
palette.role: Shadow tint and near-white lavender surface — appears as the soft drop-shadow color (rgba 0.3) that makes cards feel like they hover

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Hairline borders, link underlines, and light dividers

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Body text secondary level and subdued border color

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Nav inactive text and lightest nav border

palette.name: Wisteria
palette.role: Primary lavender card surfaces, badge backgrounds, and brand-accent fills — the soft purple room tone

palette.name: Periwinkle
palette.role: Mid-violet badge fills and icon highlights — deeper brand accent used sparingly inside lavender contexts

palette.name: Lime Voltage
palette.role: High-energy accent card surface and highlight badge — the vivid chartreuse that creates urgency and visual stop

palette.name: Sky Signal
palette.role: Info badge background and location-tag accent — cool blue for map/location context
